summary: Microsoft's total funding commitments to OpenAI are $13B, of which $11.6B was funded by September 30, 2025; about a 27% stake after the October 2025 recapitalization.
notes: Cumulative commitments made in tranches since 2019, as reported in Microsoft's 10-Q. The announced date is the as-of date of that figure, not of any single tranche. The roughly $135B value of the stake is a valuation, not money paid, so it is not stored as an amount.
